role_and_message.evidence: The motivation remains difficulty of rotated and curved text recovery, illustrated by the same failures across methods.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: Both text cases and all five method/reference rows remain, with ten complete photo/detail/metric cells.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: Every recognition string, PSNR and SSIM value remains original, including red PRPS/ME O/H/M errors, bold Ours metrics and the original green slash.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Every red ROI and enlargement connection is part of the restored cell; no new comparison link or causal relationship is introduced.

visual_encodings.evidence: Red error characters and red image ROI outlines retain their original meaning. The isolated green slash is preserved without assigning a new meaning.

examples_and_data.evidence: Ten complete source image-and-metric regions were independently checked at integer nearest-neighbour scale; no recovered text texture or number is regenerated.

unsupported_additions.evidence: Rotated/Curved text headings, R/P/S definitions and red-error legend are supported explicitly by the caption and p1 introduction.

complete_visible_content.evidence: All cells and all metric text are visible; former vertical method labels are re-expressed as full horizontal method names.

remaining_limitations: Original scientific scope and source resolution retained. Repeated reference labels, colour choices and layout imperfections remain for independent quality scoring; no score-informed revision.
